sections.heading: How to Get FSSAI Registration in India: Documents, Fees & Process
paragraphs: Opening a restaurant is only the beginning of a great idea or a great recipe. There are just a handful of legal standards you need to attend to before you start taking customers to ensure your business goes well. One of the major ones is FSSAI registration in India.

If you are planning to open a cafe, run a cloud kitchen, sell homemade food or start an edible factory, it is essential to get the registration as it permits you to follow the food safety laws and build trust among your customers. It also demonstrates that your business cares about quality and hygiene.

Registering your business has never been easier with Services Plus where we cut out all the usual hassle and delays. We will handle the paperwork correctly so that you can focus on growing your business. We will guide you by means of every step from things you need to be familiar with to filling in the form.

If you plan to operate in the standard manufacture, storage, shipment, distribution, or sale of regulated food products, you are likely to be required to obtain an FSSAI registration or license before starting regular business activities. It is published by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), an official agency that regulates dietary safety in the nation.

An FSSAI registration in India is more than a legal requirement; it provides customers with an assurance that your organization meets the required standards on food safety, hygiene and excellence. Services Plus also helps businesses to run without legal complications and gain reputation in the market.
In simple terms, it benefits you:
Keep your food business legal.
Follow food export license and sanitation procedures.
Gain the confidence of customers and business partners.
Don’t get penalized for not meeting requirements.
Grow your business with more confidence.

Preparing to submit an FSSAI apply online it matters to be aware of the level of required registration or license that will be appropriate to the business needs. Knowing the right group to start with saves time and unnecessary tweaks down the road.

Not all food businesses need the exact same type of registration. The type of permit you need will depend on things like your own annual revenue, the size of your business and the nature of your business. Selecting the correct category in the beginning prevents hold-ups in the application procedure.

This registration is mostly for tiny food businesses, startups, home-based food sellers and small-scale food vendors with lower yearly turnover. It’s the first step toward officially running a food business.

Businesses operating on a medium scale usually require a state license. Suitable for restaurants, food manufacturers, storage units, distributors and other businesses within the turnover limits of the state authorities.
